sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def gcount():
    return sum(1 for row in current_frame.ascii.split('\n') for ch in row if ch=='G')
# back to rows 29-46
action(['DOWN']*6,intent='explore')
print("back, G",gcount())
# rotate and check
for i in range(3):
    r=action(['SPACE'],intent='explore')
    if r.get('done') or r.get('level_completed'): print("DONE rot",i); break
    ws=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(current_frame.ascii.split('\n')) for c,ch in enumerate(row) if ch=='W']
    rs=[x[0] for x in ws];cs=[x[1] for x in ws]
    print("rot",i+1,"G",gcount(),"bbox rows",min(rs),max(rs),"cols",min(cs),max(cs))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
